{{Quote|My friends, I have need of your services once again. I have an extremely valuable cargo that needs to be shipped to the palace of Lungru the Hutt on Joodrudda. It is a gift, meant to seal a bargain between our two clans.|Mika Anjiliac Chiera|<ref name="TF" />}}
The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Lungru Nokko Vimmas|Lungru]] maintained a '''summer palace''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Joodrudda]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika]], the leader of the [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clan]], sent two [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|Corellian sand panthers]] to the palace as a gift to Lungru.

==Description==
The summer palace of [[Lungru Nokko Vimmas|Lungru]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was situated on [[Joodrudda]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TF" /> located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> close to the border of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="TF" /> The palace was a sprawling structure<ref name="TEA" /> and was the only building of significance on the mostly uninhabited Joodrudda. The retreat was served by a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] situated half a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] away from the residence and it was defended by two [[Seltiss-2 caravel|Hutt caravels]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Joodrudda, which monitored access to the palace.<ref name="TF" /> Lungru kept in the retreat her personal menagerie of rare and exotic creatures, where they were far away from the view of prying environmentalists.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|172|Joodrudda}}</ref>

==History==
The palace was constructed by an eclectic [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clan]] and was in situ on Joodrudda for several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="TEA" /> From at least the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Hutt Lungru<ref name="CSWE" /> of the [[Nokko]] kajidic<ref name="Nokko">Though ''[[Tempest Feud]]'' does not explicitly identify [[Lungru Nokko Vimmas|Lungru]] as a member of the [[Nokko]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], it identifies her full name as "Lungru Nokko Vimmas" and states that a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] middle name denotes the name of their clan. Therefore it can be concluded that she was a member of the Nokko clan.</ref> utilized the palace as her summer retreat.<ref name="CSWE" /> She was attended to there by a retinue of [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] retainers, including her chief advisor [[Kir Sesad]].<ref name="TF" />

{{RPG|''[[Tempest Feud]]''}}
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> to seal an agreement between their respective clans, the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika]] of the [[Anjiliac]] kajidic gifted two [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|Corellian sand panthers]] to Lungru to add to her menagerie. Mika hired<ref name="TF" /> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]]<ref name="Agents">In ''Tempest Feud'' the player characters roleplay as the agents hired by Mika. The [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], an adaptation of ''Tempest Feud'', portrays Mander Zuma, [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] as undertaking the actions fulfilled by the player characters in ''Tempest Feud''.</ref> to transport the creatures to Lungru at her palace on Joodrudda. Mika's agents subsequently hauled the [[panther]]s to Joodrudda and unloaded them at the landing bay that served the palace.<ref name="TF" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lungru's summer palace was created by [[Jeff Grubb]] and appeared in ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', a roleplaying adventures published on [[March 1]] [[2002]]<ref name="Amazon">{{Wizards|url=starwars/product.asp?WOC886590000|text=''Tempest Feud''}}</ref> as a supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] and set within [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity.<ref name="TF" /> The palace was later mentioned in the [[2008]] compendium ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE" /> in the entry for Joodrudda, and was also referenced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" /> In ''Tempest Feud'', the players [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the agents dispatched by Mika to deliver two Corellian sand panthers to the summer palace, though it is possible also for the players to decline the assignment and therefore not travel to the palace.<ref name="TF" />
